question: In the feed flow rate screening, what recovery of α-terpineol was obtained at 3.0 mL/min?
expect: 51.1% recovery (the content falls to 53.0% over 2.0-3.0 mL/min) (Effect of feed flow rate)
rendered:
Document: "Green enrichment of α-terpineol from niaouli oil residue via molecular distillation"

Page 5: "At a ow rate of 3.0 mL min^−1, efficient evaporation resulted in a high recovery (88.9%) but only moderate purity (67.7%) due to the co-evaporation of other volatile compounds."

So, the recovery of α-terpineol at 3.0 mL/min is 88.9%.
